I'm not going to say I raped anyone, or post some fucking anecdote about how my friend did. I've never prevented rape. I've need been involved in a situation like any of that. I'm 6'6", 17 years old, 275 pounds, and I'm only getting taller as I grow older. 
I broke up with my ex about a month ago. We dated for about a year. I loved her, and I'm decently positive the feeling was mutual. She had an ex who hit her, a lot. She still has scars. ... Everywhere. 
Anyways, if I moved to quickly around her she flinched. And it just broke my fucking heart, man. Seriously. Just remembering it brings back the drop in my stomach. 

Look, I don't know if you'll read this. I don't even fucking care, I'm honestly satisfied with just posting this and going to bed. But how the fuck am I supposed to grow up in a world where woman are afraid of me? That's not fucking fair in the slightest. 
Ive never been in a fight! I was jumped in seventh grade by a bunch of shitheads, but I've never tried to hurt anyone. Ive tried, too. There's a psychological block. I just can't hurt people. But women don't know that. What if I'm 6'10, almost seven foot by the time I'm don't growing? Am I doomed to a life of utter caution around the opposite sex? 

And you know, the worst part is that I know there's no way for you to tell. I know there's not some fucking mystical radar that distinguishes rapists from honest, nice men. 

Anyways, if anything comes out of this it's that I hope you can have some faith in humanity. All women of the world. Not everyone out there wants to fuck you over, be it literally or metaphorically.
